prompt:
Character turnaround reference for a 3D modeller. The input image is the user's original drawing of Sisi, a sleepy green lizard, shown from the RIGHT SIDE. Draw the SAME character, same drawing style, same colored-pencil texture, same outline color (dark blue-green), same colors, same proportions and same height, but seen from DIRECTLY IN FRONT (front orthographic view, facing the viewer, perfectly symmetric pose, standing upright, no perspective tilt).

Keep exactly: very large round head (about as wide as the body), short rounded muzzle, BOTH eyes visible on the upper sides of the head with the same heavy half-closed sleepy lids (lid color lighter green) and low dark pupils looking slightly down, round yellow cheek blush on each cheek, a thin forked tongue poking out from the middle of the mouth toward the viewer, short neck, plump pear-shaped upright body, pale lime belly patch on the front of the body, two short soft arms hanging at the sides, two short rounded flat webbed feet at the bottom, the darker green scalloped back ridge just peeking out at the top of the head edges and behind the body, the tail visible behind/beside one foot resting on the ground.

Plain warm ivory paper background, character centered with generous empty margin, no shadow, no text, no other characters, no props. Not a 3D render: a flat 2D drawing exactly like the original.
